reels.title: UFC influenceri, tisuće dolara i nula preuzimanja
reels.hook: Tisuće dolara na influencere — nula preuzimanja
reels.why: Skupa pogreška s jasnim obratom: publika UFC-a gleda s pivom i pizzom i ne želi brojati kalorije. Pouka je duhovita i odmah se pamti.
reels.speaker: Jake Castillo
reels.quote: the average person watching UFC is doing so on their couch as they're drinking beer and eating pizza with their friends.

reels.quote: if it feels like an ad, it's not going to go viral.
